The route is used only when a destinatio: The route is used only when a destination rule points to it: it is not chosen automatically and does not appear among routes that can be forced. To connect to the relay, only the part of the chain before the relay hop is used.
Traffic goes through the first hop, then: Traffic goes through the first hop, then the second through the first, and so on to the exit. Schemes: http://host:port, socks5://host:port, or relay://contact email: the chain stops at the relay hop (previous hops are used to reach the relay, subsequent ones go through the contact). A hop marked "Rules only" stops the chain if no rule selects the route. A PAC hop evaluates a PAC file and must be the only hop in the chain. A Dynamic hop evaluates the rules for the destination and applies the chosen route; if none matches it continues direct, and must be the last hop. Typing relay:// shows contacts and their devices; hops already used are also suggested.
